title: Assyria destroys the northern kingdom of Israel
summary: Assyria destroys the northern kingdom of Israel
description: Record first created by the Generations curriculum import (Preparing the World for Jesus (1st ed., 2020)). CFAH dates it as well (added by the CFAH pass); the sort follows the four-tier rule.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 1: CFAH anchor point: 722 BC (AP-87, OSF preprint CFAH-14). Sort changed by the CFAH pass (2026-10-18): was cfah-table1 721 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-14: Ancient Assyria," OSF preprint v1.0 (27 Feb 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/9FUW2, file CFAH-14_Assyria_v_1.0.pdf, p. 16, heading "Accession of Sargon II, Fall of Samaria - 722 BC - Anchor Point #87"
chronologies.note: CFAH-14 uses the number #87 twice on p. 16 (here and for Shamshi-Adad IV in 1053 BC); see open question I1.

chronologies.date: 721 or 720 BC (Fall of Samaria, see Gertoux (2015, 1–34))
chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 1: Problem, Data, and Methodology," ARJ 15 (2022): 377–390, section "Our Assumptions (Declared Biases)", Table 1 "Biblically derived dates from Ussher and Jones"
chronologies.note: CFAH-1 Table 1 (Ussher-Jones biblical baseline adopted by CFAH); not a triangulated anchor point. Printed as alternatives, "721 or 720"; the sort uses the first.

chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 279 (PDF p. 314)
chronologies.note: Jones prints 721 BC. CFAH anchor point 722 BC keeps the sort. The year agrees with CFAH-1 Table 1 (721 or 720), not with the anchor point.

chronologies.citation: Preparing the World for Jesus (1st ed., 2020), ch. 6 "The Special People of God", PDF p. 204 (printed p. 203)
chronologies.note: p. 305 and the Timeline Review (p. 212) print 721 BC.
chronologies.edition_note: 1st ed. (2020); superseded by the 2nd ed. (2024), which prints "721 BC" (PDF p. 361): 1 year later.

chronologies.citation: Preparing the World for Jesus (1st ed., 2020), ch. 10 "The Assyrian Empire: Power by Cruelty (1200–612 BC)", PDF p. 305 (printed p. 304)
chronologies.edition_note: 1st ed. (2020); superseded by the 2nd ed. (2024), which prints "721 BC" (PDF p. 361): the same date.

chronologies.citation: Preparing the World for Jesus (2nd ed., 2024), ch. 14 "Old Babylon–The Rising Threats to Israel", PDF p. 361 (printed p. 347)
chronologies.note: Sargon II deports the rest of Israel; also pp. 377, 417. p. 388 prints 722 BC.

chronologies.citation: Morecraft, A Christian Survey of World History, p. 18 (PDF p. 27)
chronologies.note: Assyria depopulates the Northern Kingdom. Repeated on PDF p. 33.

chronologies.citation: Morecraft, A Christian Survey of World History, p. 42 (PDF p. 50)
chronologies.note: From the book's "Ancient Empires" pages (credited in an image to Daily Bible Study, keyway.ca). Reign of Shalmaneser V, who besieged Samaria.
